acceptance_checks.description: Each emitted CUSTBILL record is 65 characters with the documented column layout.
Repeated extraction for the same namespace produces byte-identical output.
The Flask endpoint serves the persisted Perl report and labels it as batch output.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: ASCII fixed-width records with newline delimiters.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: Customer identifiers and names are truncated to their legacy field widths.

malformed_record_policy.details: Missing customer text is padded; amounts are rounded half up to cents.

empty_input_semantics.details: The chain writes a zero-row finance report for a namespace with no invoice headers.

planted_anomalies.description: The .xls artifact is a byte-identical CSV copy, not a native workbook.
